subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Should xAI image generation accept both `browser.ssrfPolicy` and `models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork` as operator authorization to reach private endpoints?
rationale: Both settings already exist, but enabling either one changes an SSRF authorization boundary for xAI image requests; repository policy requires an explicit owner choice rather than inferring security scope solely from analogous providers.

options.title: Accept both existing opt-ins
options.body: Allow browser SSRF policy to override the default and let provider request configuration flow through the canonical sanitized request path.

options.title: Provider-scoped opt-in only
options.body: Honor only `models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork` for xAI image generation and keep browser policy isolated from provider traffic.

options.title: Keep xAI deny-private
options.body: Retain the hardcoded denial and treat private-network xAI image endpoints as unsupported.

recommendation.title: Accept both existing opt-ins
recommendation.body: Allow browser SSRF policy to override the default and let provider request configuration flow through the canonical sanitized request path.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is authorship of shared SSRF trust and provider-request policy code that defines this choice.
